Built on the [Langchain](https://python.langchain.com/v0.2/docs/introduction/) framework, ROSA helps you interact with robots using natural language, making robotics development more accessible and efficient. #### ROSA Demo: NeBula-Spot in JPL's Mars Yard (click for YouTube) [![Spot YouTube Thumbnail](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19a99b5c-6103-4be4-8875-1810cf4558c5)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mZTrSg7tEsA) ## 🚀 Quick Start ### Requirements - Python 3.9+ - ROS Noetic or higher ### Installation ```bash pip3 install jpl-rosa ``` ### Usage Examples ```python from rosa import ROSA llm = get_your_llm_here() agent = ROSA(ros_version=1, llm=llm) agent.invoke("Show me a list of topics that have publishers but no subscribers") ``` For detailed information on configuring the LLM, please refer to our [Model Configuration Wiki page](https://github.com/nasa-jpl/rosa/wiki/Model-Configuration). ## Adapting ROSA for Your Robot 🔧 ROSA is designed to be easily adaptable to different robots and environments. You can create custom agents by either inheriting from the `ROSA` class or creating a new instance with custom parameters. For detailed information on creating custom agents, adding tools, and customizing prompts, please refer to our [Custom Agents Wiki page](https://github.com/nasa-jpl/rosa/wiki/Custom-Agents). ## TurtleSim Demo 🐢 We have included a demo that uses ROSA to control the TurtleSim robot in simulation.
